verdict.rationale: Ollama's own materials say it runs open models locally and that 'Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.' Its API is served at localhost:11434, and community users independently describe it as the easiest way to run LLMs locally. Cloud models are an optional separate mode and do not undermine local-only operation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of offline/no-telemetry guarantees and of how to make sure requests never route to Ollama Cloud.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device

citations.quote: Nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine.
Your prompts are never tracked or trained on.
Ollama is the easiest way to run open AI models locally or in the cloud
Ollama is definitely the easiest way to run LLMs locally
all running on your own device
